title: MAC FM · Monday 5 October 2026
description: MAC Fellas, good morning. It’s Alex and Maya here for your unofficial MAC FM update. Morning! IATA data shows global air cargo demand rose 4.4% in August, while passenger traffic slipped. Interesting divergence. That might signal a continued shift toward dedicated freighters and belly-hold optimization. Speaking of freighters, NX Group and JAL just launched a new 747F service. Adding widebody capacity in Asia-Pacific could intensify competition on high-volume lanes. It might also influence yield management for similar network operators. Keep an eye on those trade lanes. That’s all for now.

sources.title: IATA reports 4.4% rise in global air cargo demand for August
NX Group and JAL launch new 747F cargo service

title: MAC FM · Saturday 3 October 2026
description: MAC Fellas, morning. Flydubai Cargo just launched its first scheduled B737-800 freighter network. Three dedicated narrowbodies? That’s a big shift for regional capacity. Exactly. It might pull e-commerce flows away from belly space. Speaking of e-commerce, lithium battery shipments are under stricter safety review. Tighter compliance could slow down handling for high-volume electronics. Definitely something to watch. Stay sharp, everyone.

sources.title: Flydubai Cargo launches scheduled B737-800 freighter network
E-commerce growth intensifies scrutiny on lithium battery safety
